proprietary_cut.rule: Necessary condition for Intents volume; not additive revenue line
proprietary_cut.do_not: Double-count CS growth as a second fee engine in path/issuance-offset math
proprietary_cut.operational_risk: CS threshold/attestation failure is an Intents volume/trust kill switch, not a missed P&L line

falsifiers.description: Published paid signature API with NEAR or stable tariff per sign/respond routing to a named collector
NEAR-denominated signature fees in DefiLlama holders-revenue wallets or a distinct CS adapter line
Mandatory stake-to-sign with slashable bond earning signature fees
Protocol burn mechanically tied to signature count (beyond ordinary L1 gas burn)
